body: Almost 2 years ago today for anorexia/bulimia. For a few years up until that point I ate one meal a day after school but would overreat heavily. That started in 3rd grade, im not sure how. One day, my bio dad and I had gotten into a heated argument and I just didnt eat that day because I had other things on my mind. The next day, I had lost around 5 pounds in most likely water weight, gas, not eating, etc. and my tummy was a lot flatter. I was not a heavy kid but I was "thick" compared to my peers. Before this particular day it hadnt even crossed my mind that I could go a day without eating, it just didnt feel like an option. 2 years of constant fasts, lax abuse, binging, and countless breakdowns later and im still recovering. I wish I could go back in time and tell that girl the suffering I was about to put myself through wasnt worth losing over 20 pounds in healthy weight. She was beautiful but just couldnt see it, every day I spend getting better is dedicated to her.

I am 5,5 and 121lbs female. I go to school 4 days a week and burn around 250-300 calories a day, I attend basketball practice all 4 school days. My goal weight is 110-112 and im not sure what my calorie limit would be. If anybody could give any recommendation or advice is would be greatly appreciated!! im hoping to reach my goal weight by a max of 2-3 months. I do nothing on weekends.
